description: Phase-fix ledger for the WaggleDance orchestrator review pipeline. Tag-IDs (ARCH-NNN, REL-NNN, SEC-NNN) are NOT globally unique -- each review run numbers its own findings from 0. The unique key is (phase_introduced, tag). Anchors use 'path :: stable_text' so they survive line-number drift.

rows.title: Empty evidence surface in target iteration package can produce a confident review pass
rows.notes: Phase 2A-4 P9 split execution_status (CompletionVerifier) from review_readiness_status (REVIEW_READY / SUPPLEMENT_ONLY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE). Review runner refuses INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. SUPPLEMENT_ONLY allowed but reviewer must disclose.

rows.title: Redactor self-corrupts its own source when included in review surface supplement
rows.notes: Phase 2A-4 P2 added Invoke-WaggleSourceSupplementRedaction (value-shape patterns only). Real reviews show 0 self-corruption findings.

rows.title: Subprocess runner duplicated between Invoke-WaggleIteration and Invoke-WaggleReview
rows.notes: Backlog per Phase 2A-4 master prompt rule 3 (do not generalize Invoke-WaggleReviewSubprocess unless REL-005 cannot be fixed in place). REL-005 was fixed in place. Future phase: unify into one Spawn-ClaudeCodeSubprocess. Acceptance: one helper used by both entry points; Test-ReviewSubprocessTimeout still green.

rows.title: Subprocess runner duplication (formal backlog row, by tag-name)
rows.notes: Some Phase 2A-3 / 2A-4 reports use 'ARCH-002' rather than 'ARCH-001 (Phase 2A-4)' for the duplication finding; both refer to the same condition. Suggested phase: Phase 2A-6 or later. Acceptance: one shared subprocess helper; Test-ClaudeRunner + Test-ReviewSubprocessTimeout both green.

rows.title: Entry points dot-source many lib files in fragile fixed order
rows.notes: Low risk; current order works. Suggested phase: Phase 2A-6. Acceptance: a small Import-WaggleOrchestratorLibs helper owns canonical order; static check that both entry points use it.

rows.title: review/ depends back on lib/ root via ReviewAdapter -> Redactor
canonical_source_anchors: docs/design/phase2a4_backlog.md :: ARCH-004 -- review/ -> lib/ root dependency
rows.notes: Intentional reuse of the Phase 2A-1 redactor. Suggested phase: when lib/review/ becomes a package boundary. Acceptance: documented in design doc OR redactor moved into lib/review/. Phase 2A-5 documents.

rows.title: UNTRUSTED marker check is substring-only
rows.notes: Phase 2A-4 P10 anchored check: SECURITY PREAMBLE header AND UNTRUSTED DATA token must both appear in first 40 lines of llm_input_package.md.

rows.title: Phase-tag ledger gap: code comments contain ARCH/REL/SEC tags but no central ledger
rows.notes: Phase 2A-5 P1+P2 add the durable ledger and the validator that ensures every (Phase 2A-N, tag) reference in source has a row.

rows.title: Run-WaggleHardeningGates default ReportPath is hardcoded to Phase 2A-2 docs run dir
rows.notes: Phase 2A-5 P3+P4+P5: default writes to docs/runs/hardening_gates/<utc>.json + Copy-Item to latest.json (both gitignored).

rows.title: Reserved (no Phase 2A reviewer has issued REL-000 yet)
rows.notes: Placeholder so the ledger has a complete REL-000 row. If a future phase issues REL-000, replace this row.

rows.title: Lock release crash-path may not be visible / may be missing
rows.notes: Source verified: both entry points already had try/finally + Release-WaggleLock -LockId. Phase 2A-3 reviewer saw a head-truncated supplement view that did not include the finally block. Phase 2A-4 P12 keyword-window extraction ensures future reviewers see Acquire/Release windows together.

rows.title: Lockfile.ps1 not visible in supplement (Phase 2A-4 reviewer's REL-001)
rows.notes: Different finding from Phase 2A-3 REL-001 (same tag-id, different review run). Phase 2A-4 keyword-window extraction includes Lockfile.ps1 in supplement. Listed informational because no code change was specifically attributed to it.

rows.title: CompletionVerifier has tautological condition (exit_code -ne 0 -or exit_code -eq 0)
rows.notes: Phase 2A-4 P6: replaced with `if ($fExists)`. Failure signal wins regardless of exit code.

rows.title: Resume short-circuit may fire before lock acquisition
rows.notes: Phase 2A-4 P7: resume short-circuit moved inside try/finally lock so concurrent operators serialise on the lock; the one that exits cleanly still releases.

rows.title: Unique-artifact contract may not be invoked or hidden by supplement truncation
rows.notes: Source verified: CompletionVerifier calls Test-UniqueIterationArtifact when UniqueArtifactPath is supplied; Invoke-WaggleIteration supplies it when requireUniqueArtifact=true. Phase 2A-4 P4 added 5 explicit branch tests: fresh / missing / stale / wrong / disabled.

rows.title: Review subprocess timeout enforcement may be unsafe (sync ReadToEnd can block forever)
rows.notes: Phase 2A-4 P5: bounded task.Wait + Stop-ProcessTree on drain timeout. Hang scenario terminates ~3.8s under 30s ceiling.

rows.title: Signal-conflict semantics (both completed and failed signals present)
rows.notes: Phase 1.6's CompletionVerifier already returned NEEDS_REVIEW_CONFLICT when both signals are present. Phase 2A-4 P6 added explicit branch coverage.

rows.title: Partial-state recovery semantics
rows.notes: Needs design. Suggested phase: Phase 2A-6 or later, after one or two operator sessions surface real partial states. Acceptance: a decision matrix per partial-state case + tests.

rows.title: Idempotency semantics for same-iteration-id re-runs
rows.notes: Suggested phase: paired with REL-007. Acceptance: documented behavior in CLAUDE.md + a test that asserts it.

rows.title: Cross-vendor multi-LLM lane: orchestrator-only, no browser automation in Phase 2B
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. The cross-vendor lane is implemented as 7 PowerShell modules driven manually by an operator pasting bundles into chat UIs. End-to-end synthetic dry-run lives at orchestrator/Run-Phase2BEndToEndDryRun.ps1; the report is written to docs/runs/orchestrator_phase2b_cross_vendor_2026_05_06/e2e_dry_run.md.

rows.title: Epoch evidence bundler: cumulative N-iteration evidence with 20-attachment cap
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. Build-WaggleEpochEvidence computes a deterministic evidence_sha256 over the canonical sorted file list; the per-provider attachment plan enforces the 20-file cap (consolidates iter*_logs and iter*_internal_review when needed); all redacted via Invoke-WaggleRedaction.

rows.title: Provider profile abstraction: Claude Web / Gemini / Grok / GPT synthesis as configurable profiles
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. ProviderProfiles.ps1 default-fills four provider profiles (claude_web, gemini, grok, gpt_synthesis). Each carries enabled/timeout_sec/expected_model_in_ui. Disabled providers produce ok=false bundles instead of errors so the operator sees the gap.

rows.title: SHA-binding gate: source_evidence_sha256 is enforced at reviewer import, synthesis import, and iteration launch
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. Three-way SHA agreement is enforced: the bundler stamps evidence_sha256 in epoch_evidence.json; reviewer + synthesizer responses must echo the same value; the iteration launcher recomputes from disk and refuses on mismatch. SHA-mismatch is exercised in tests at all three boundaries.

rows.title: HALT marker: synthesis can decide work is complete; orchestrator stops cleanly
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. decision=halt writes HALT.md with the synthesis_summary; trigger library returns decision=halt when the marker is present; iteration launcher refuses on non-continue decisions. The trigger library prioritizes pause > halt > early-trigger > cumulative.

rows.title: External response redaction: imported reviewer outputs run through redactor before storage
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. Both reviewer and synthesis importers apply Invoke-WaggleRedaction to the entire response BEFORE storing it. Synthetic GitHub PAT in test fixtures is redacted before disk write; synthetic prompt-injection lines are preserved verbatim but inert (they are stored markdown, not executed).
